text:
Marcus: Heads-up - we have a one-off purchase request for a licensed analytics plugin (team: Growth). It's under $10k but exceeds the normal SaaS auto-approve because it's a perpetual seat.
Anya: Can you paste the vendor and justification? also needs a PO exception if it's not standard SSO/vendors.
Marcus: Vendor: QuietMetrics Inc. Use-case: dashboarding for trial cohorts. Annual maintenance + one-time perpetual seat migration tool. Total $9,750. Benefit: reduces manual churn analysis by ~6 engineer days/month.
Jordan: If it's < $10k it can be fast-tracked but finance needs a short business case + security sign-off. @Elaine do we have SSO + data access review on file for QuietMetrics?
Elaine: Not on file. Security needs an app review (3-5 business days). We can do expedited review if product sends config sheet and a temporary test account.
Samir: Growth can provide test account. I'll ask them to send the config doc and env diagram to security@redwood.com today.
Marcus: Great. Also curious about delegation - can a manager approve this instead of the VP since it's sub-10k?
FinanceBot: Auto-response: For purchases under company threshold ($10,000), delegated approver flow applies. If vendor is not pre-approved, Procurement review required. See https://redwood.company/finance/procurement-delegation
Anya: OK. To proceed we need: 1) 1-paragraph business case, 2) vendor contact + W9, 3) security expedited request, 4) PO exception form (for perpetual seat).
Marcus: I'll assemble. Draft below — can someone quick-ack and add edits?
Marcus: "Growth needs the QuietMetrics dashboard license to automate trial cohort reporting. This reduces manual work and shortens trial-to-conversion by estimated 2-3 days. Total cost $9,750 (one-time + year 1 maintenance)."
Jordan: LGTM. Add expected ROI metric (% lift or time saved).
Elaine: Also add data scopes (no PII, only aggregated metrics). Security will expedite if that's explicit.
Samir: Sending vendor W9 now.
Marcus: Uploaded PO exception request to procurement portal. Exception ID printed below.
Marcus: ```PO-EXC-2026-45
vendor: QuietMetrics Inc.
amount: 9750
reason: perpetual seat + migration tooling
contact: lisa@quietmetrics.com
```
Procurement: Received. We'll kick off the pre-approval checklist and flag this as fast-track since amount < $10k and security is expediting. Expect response within 24-48 hours. :thumbsup:
Anya: For records - can we ask Growth to tag the cost center and estimated monthly carry (maintenance) so budget can be updated?
Marcus: Done. Cost center: GROWTH-TRIALS. Maintenance after year 1 estimated <$1k/yr.
Procurement: Noted. Once security replies, Procurement will route to delegated approver (Manager-level) for sign-off. If manager approves, no PO board review needed.
FinanceBot: Reminder: please attach vendor invoice to this thread when available. Also attach W9 and vendor bank details for ACH onboarding.
Marcus: Invoice attached. W9 sent. Banking details pending.
Elaine: Security approved the expedited review - no PII, restricted scopes. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Manager approval granted (Jordan). Proceeding with PO creation.
Procurement: PO created and issued (PO-2026-9981). Please ensure vendor reference included on invoice so payment can process in next AP run.
Marcus: Thanks everyone. Closing loop - tagging for visibility: @Samir @Anya @Elaine :tada:
FinanceBot: Thread archived to finance logs.
